presets.title: Quick check
presets.detail: Only the fast behind-the-scenes checks. Nothing opens on screen. A few minutes.

presets.title: Full check
presets.detail: Everything on every Apple device. Takes a long time, and the Mac part takes over your screen.

suites.title: App logic
suites.detail: Quick behind-the-scenes checks of how the app thinks: picking video quality, what plays next, subtitles and so on. Nothing is tapped on screen. Runs on a test iPhone, a test Apple TV and this Mac.

options.title: Leave out this Mac
options.help: Skips the Mac part, for example while you are using Aquarium on this Mac.

suites.title: Watch logic
suites.detail: The same kind of quick behind-the-scenes checks, for the Apple Watch app.

suites.title: iPhone
suites.detail: Opens the app on test iPhones and uses it the way a person would: signing in, browsing, opening titles, playing video, changing settings. Runs on four sizes of iPhone, one after another.

options.title: Which iPhone
options.help: All four takes about four times as long as one.

options.title: Skip tidying the test account first
options.help: Each run normally starts by putting its test account back to a known state. Skipping that is a little quicker, but leftovers from the last run can cause false alarms.

suites.title: iPad
suites.detail: Opens the app on a test iPad and uses it the way a person would: the sidebar, libraries, search, the player, downloads and settings.

options.title: Skip tidying the test account first
options.help: Each run normally starts by putting its test account back to a known state. Skipping that is a little quicker, but leftovers from the last run can cause false alarms.

suites.title: Apple TV
suites.detail: Opens the app on a test Apple TV and drives it with the remote: moving focus, browsing, playing, Live TV and settings.

options.title: Skip tidying the test account first
options.help: Each run normally starts by putting its test account back to a known state. Skipping that is a little quicker, but leftovers from the last run can cause false alarms.

suites.title: Apple Watch
suites.detail: Opens the watch app on a test Apple Watch and uses it: Home, the library, playback and downloads.

options.title: Skip tidying the test account first
options.help: Each run normally starts by putting its test account back to a known state. Skipping that is a little quicker, but leftovers from the last run can cause false alarms.

suites.title: Mac
suites.detail: Opens the Mac app on this Mac and uses it: windows, the sidebar, menus, browsing and the player.
suites.note: This one takes over your screen, mouse and keyboard while it runs, so leave the Mac alone until it finishes. Quit Aquarium first; it will not start while Aquarium is open.

options.title: Skip tidying the test account first
options.help: Each run normally starts by putting its test account back to a known state. Skipping that is a little quicker, but leftovers from the last run can cause false alarms.

suites.title: Linux app logic
suites.detail: Quick behind-the-scenes checks of the Linux app's screens and logic.
suites.note: Needs developer tools that are not on every Mac. If it says it can't run here, that is why; these checks also run automatically online.

suites.title: Linux app and server
suites.detail: Checks that the Linux app talks to the test server correctly.
suites.note: Needs developer tools that are not on every Mac. If it says it can't run here, that is why; these checks also run automatically online.

suites.title: Linux app core
suites.detail: Checks of the Linux app's core: downloads, settings and the server connection.
suites.note: Needs developer tools that are not on every Mac. If it says it can't run here, that is why; these checks also run automatically online.
